comparison.objective: Seat three boxes in keyed rail bays.
comparison.physical_skill: Box-to-rail alignment, guided insertion, and placement against end stops.
comparison.success_condition: One box per bay, flat between rails, with one end within 5 mm of the end stop.
comparison.reason: Guided bay placement with a pose tolerance differs from impact fracture, overload avoidance, and containment of released metal fragments.
